units.source_text: 扫除完毕，大家开始各自回到正殿去，只有我经过夕佳亭侧面，从通向大书院后面的小路走回去。

en.t: When the cleaning was finished, everyone began returning to the main hall, each on his own; only I passed beside the Sekkatei and went back along the narrow path leading behind the large study.

units.source_text: 因为大书院后面还没有清扫。

en.t: That was because the area behind the large study had not yet been cleaned.
